ad_library.summary: 6 live Meta ads confirmed on 2026-11-21 on the page sribalajisolarenergies (page ID 108499924234875). The two ads reproduced above were each opened directly by library ID and both render the same page and the same Telugu card. All ads sell residential rooftop solar on a Rs.0-upfront, Rs.1,355-a-month EMI offer against the Rs.78,000 PM Surya Ghar subsidy, and every one of them clicks to an fb.me lead form rather than the website. The website was read live the same day. Google Ads Transparency records were not checked in this pass.

funnel.destination: Facebook lead form (FB.ME) - Sign up / Get offer
funnel.meaning: Every live ad sends the click to an fb.me lead form. The traffic never touches sribalajisolarenergies.com, so no URL can carry UTMs, the site cannot set a retargeting audience, and the company cannot see which ad produced which enquiry - while it pays for six ads at once.

findings: All 6 live ads click to fb.me lead forms, so the traffic never reaches the new website. No UTM can be attached, no retargeting audience can be built, and ad-to-enquiry attribution is impossible without opening Ads Manager.

The home page's primary call to action, 'Click Here', links to pmsuryaghar.gov.in/consumerLogin - the national portal, not the company's own enquiry flow. The biggest button on the page hands the visitor to the government and loses them.

The social-proof counters contradict each other across the site: the home page renders '0+ Project Done', '0+ Happy Clients', '0+ Award Winnings', '0+ Rating Customer', while the /about page for the same company reads 1000+ projects, 1200+ happy clients, 850+ awards and 1100+ rated customers - and the ads claim 10,000+ customers. Three numbers for the same fact, none of them sourced.

The displayed phone number and the dialled number disagree: the contact page shows +91 903 204 1774 but the tel: link dials +91 951 595 49 23, and neither matches the numbers the company is empanelled and advertised under (+91 9959491774 / +91 87024 44646).

The contact page states 'Our Address: Hyderabad', but the registered head office is #6-1-34 Chintala Narasimhulu Complex, Lashkar Bazar, Hanumakonda, Warangal 506001. No street address for the office the customer would actually visit appears anywhere on the site.

The age claim is inconsistent across the company's own channels: one live ad says '14 years of trust', another says '15-year legacy', the site says 'established in the year 2011' in one paragraph and 'established in the year 2013' in the next.

The ads sell on 'Rs.0 upfront' and 'Rs.1,355/month EMI', but the website restates neither figure and has no EMI or zero-upfront explanation anywhere, so the offer that earns the click disappears on landing.
The home page has no contact form and no WhatsApp link - the only form is on /contact - while the ads already collect details through Meta, so the site offers the visitor no equivalent next step.
The page title is 82 characters and will be truncated in search results, and the site carries a Google Maps embed but no structured LocalBusiness data was captured in this pass.

The /Projects page - the proof page a serious buyer clicks to - is a bare image gallery of about 40 photos with no project name, capacity, location or date on any of them, so the strongest asset the company owns cannot be checked or quoted.
next_steps: Send the ads to the website, with tracking
Point at least one of the six ads at a landing page on sribalajisolarenergies.com carrying UTMs and a Meta Pixel, and keep the fb.me form as a secondary path. The six-ad spend is currently invisible.
Take the government link off the primary button
Re-point 'Click Here' at an on-site quote form; move the pmsuryaghar.gov.in login to a clearly secondary 'apply for subsidy' step after the lead is captured.

Replace the home page's '0+ Project Done' and '0+ Happy Clients' with one set of real numbers, and use the same numbers on the /about page (which currently says 1000+ projects / 1200+ clients) and in the ads (10,000+ customers). The site already names real installs - Collector Office Suryapet, Relief Hospital Arepally 54 kW, Talla Padmavathi 56 kW, Vagdevi Junior College 30 kW - that can be counted.

The /about page call-to-action block still reads 'It is a long established fact that a reader will be distracted by the readable content of a page when looking at its layout' - unreplaced template text on a page a prospect reaches from the main menu.
Make the displayed number, the tel: link, the TGREDCO record and the ad account all use one number that is actually answered.
Replace 'Our Address: Hyderabad' with the Lashkar Bazar, Hanumakonda 506001 head office, and add the Warangal service area the ads already promise.
Put the zero-upfront and EMI offer on the landing page
Restate 'Rs.0 upfront' and 'Rs.1,355/month' with the conditions on the page, so the promise in the ad survives the click.

site_audit.platform: React single-page app (static/media + static/js bundles), client-rendered
site_audit.scope_note: The website was read live on 2026-11-21 through a rendered-content fetch of the home page and /contact. Tracking-pixel and head checks (Meta Pixel, GA4, GTM, Google Ads, meta description, Open Graph, JSON-LD, favicon) need the raw served HTML and were not captured through this channel, so they are recorded as not checked rather than absent. PageSpeed and sitemap were not run.

issues: No contact form on homepage — visitors can't easily enquire
No WhatsApp link — losing mobile leads (WhatsApp converts 3x better for Indian home services)
Only 1-2 CTA buttons — could be more aggressive
No live chat — missing after-hours leads

site_evidence.note: Head HTML not captured through the sandbox fetch channel; pixel presence is not checked, not asserted absent. No UTM parameters appear on any link found in the rendered page content.

promise_gap.site: The website never mentions a zero-upfront plan. There is no EMI calculator, no financing partner and no terms for the Rs.0 offer the ad is built on.

promise_gap.promise: Rs.1,355 per month EMI instead of a current bill
promise_gap.site: No monthly figure appears anywhere on the site, and no system size or tenure is stated for it.
The site's own counter reads '0+ Happy Clients', directly contradicting the ad.
The home page headline names PM Surya Ghar and the hero repeats Rs.78,000, but the primary button sends the visitor to the national portal login rather than an on-site explanation of eligibility.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
